replies.author: GuyNamedRiley
replies.body:
The color palette isn't that original. We see a lot of stone/cobblestone/stone brick combinations. Maybe add some sort of pattern to the floor. 

Another problem is that this map suffers from the same problem as clay wars, where the monuments are too close to the spawn. If players are defending this map will become a stalemate.

Also the general design of the map is so similar to a lot of Avicus maps. It looks like either one side of justice 2, or the front half of Rendezvous. It's not unique enough.

One of the only good things this map has going for it is it's space. I do like close quarter maps, however it might be close of quarters, and the void space could use some work.

-.1
